Hi all

Sorry it's taken a while, but here's the new version of the holography plate exposure calculator. It's written in VB.Net and should run on most modern machines. You'll need to unzip the files first and then run Setup. I think it's fairly self explanatory, but if you experience any difficulties please post on this forum to let me know.

📎 [Exposure Calculator Files.zip](https://holographyforum.org/forum/download/file.php?id=5961)

Comments and feedack (either good or bad) are always welcome 

Cheers

Jem
